description: Public cloud preset timestamp reconciliation preserves local configuration and persists refreshed metadata for stale, equal and unknown timestamps.

mutants.description: Treat an equal cloud timestamp as a newer update; the equal-timestamp row must retain local configuration and the early-return result.
Mark an equal timestamp as stale; the equal row must clear an old hold marker while a strictly older cloud row records update.
Omit persistence of the reconciled identity and timestamp metadata; the fresh sidecar read must observe the post-load values rather than the seeded local values.
